suggestions.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
suggestions.method: Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
suggestions.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

suggestions.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
suggestions.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.
suggestions.scope_rule: If you change the card's premise, record scope_status=changed and explain why. A package metadata check cannot establish mathematical relevance.

suggestions.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
suggestions.method: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
suggestions.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

suggestions.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
suggestions.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.
suggestions.scope_rule: If you change the card's premise, record scope_status=changed and explain why. A package metadata check cannot establish mathematical relevance.

next_step: Check live overlap, refine one question's object and domain, and record a bounded task card. A different seed or scope key is not evidence of novelty.
